claims: Pentagón Jr. was born on February 5, 1985.
Pentagón Jr. is known as Penta or Penta El Zero Miedo.
Pentagón Jr. is a 41-year-old Mexican masked luchador.
Pentagón Jr. signed with WWE in late 2024.
Pentagón Jr. appears on the Raw brand.
Pentagón Jr. is the WWE Intercontinental Champion.
Pentagón Jr. won the WWE Intercontinental Championship on March 2, 2026.
Pentagón Jr.'s real name is not publicly confirmed.
Rey Fénix is Pentagón Jr.'s brother.
Pentagón Jr. had time in AEW and AAA with his brother Rey Fénix.
Pentagón Jr. worked in Lucha Underground.
Pentagón Jr. worked in Impact Wrestling.
Pentagón Jr. was part of the Lucha Brothers.
